topic: A compilation of funny and goofy moments featuring NBA player Scottie Barnes during interviews, live broadcasts, and stream dances.

hook.first_words: Hey Scottie, we met last week.
hook.first_frame: Scottie Barnes sitting at a press conference table behind a microphone.
hook.on_screen_text_0_3s: hey Scottie we met last week

shots.shows: Scottie Barnes sitting at a press conference table listening to a reporter's question.
Live TV reporter speaking into a microphone while Scottie Barnes eats lunch behind him and stares at the camera.
Scottie Barnes smiling and laughing at the press conference.
Live TV reporter reporting on contract extension while Scottie photobombs and makes goofy faces in the background.
Scottie Barnes responding at the press conference table.
Quick clip of Scottie Barnes standing behind reporter outside the venue.
Scottie Barnes stating he was bored at the press conference.
Scottie Barnes speaking into media scrum microphones and imitating Kawhi Leonard's laugh.
Scottie Barnes tripping and falling on the floor inside the arena tunnel in a red tracksuit.
Scottie Barnes wearing headphones doing a goofy dance in front of his computer gaming chair.

ending.last_frame: Scottie Barnes dancing enthusiastically in his room while wearing a gaming headset.

script: Hey Scottie, we met last week. Scottie Barnes here behind us, just enjoying a little bit of lunch and people asking me if that was staged. The extension has gone through for 115 million dollars over two seasons. It was not staged at all. I don't know, I was bored to be honest. They can go on Google and look it up. Kawhi laugh. Falls. Goofy dance.
what_makes_it_work: Authentic and funny photobombing reactions from an NBA player in live broadcast background clips.
Fast-paced editing contrasting quiet press conference moments with chaotic funny footage.
Humorous self-awareness and iconic funny moments like his Kawhi Leonard laugh impression.
